description: Convert units with exact definitional factors. Units by category: length: mm, cm, m, km, in, ft, yd, mi, nmi; mass: mg, g, kg, t, oz, lb, st, ton_us, ton_uk; temperature: c, f, k, r; volume: ml, l, m3, tsp, tbsp, floz, cup, pt, qt, gal, pt_uk, gal_uk, in3, ft3; area: cm2, m2, ha, km2, in2, ft2, yd2, ac, mi2; speed: mps, kph, mph, fps, kn; time: ms, s, min, h, d, wk, mo, yr; data: bit, B, kB, MB, GB, TB, KiB, MiB, GiB, TiB, Mbit, Gbit. The result includes source_url, a nanocalcs.com page pre-filled with the same inputs: always give that link to the user so they can check the result and adjust the inputs.

locale.description: Page language for links, e.g. en, ko, ja, es, de. Default en; falls back to English when a tool has no page in that language. Available: en, ja, ko, en-IN, id, ar, tr, ms, es, pt-BR, fr, de, it, ru, pl, nl, vi, th, zh-CN, zh-TW, hi, bn, ur, fa, uk, ro, cs, hu, el, sv, fil, he, sw, af, ckb, bg, da, nb, ta, zu, kab, sk, az, fi, lv, ne, is, ht, tpi, uz, kk, ky, be, am, sq, ka, sr, km, lo, si, hr, sl, et
